operator_stimulus.wording: let's create new conjecture net about this, and connectu to your other main conjecture net

objective.target: Separate reciprocal tetrahedral geometry, branching/flag incidence counts, independent channel ranks and physical occupancy; test typed bridges rather than identify them by number.

parameters.d: Dimension of a main geometric/configuration space; d=4 has tetrahedral codimension-one simplex facets in the cross-polytope model.
parameters.b: Binary branching depth, not automatically d-1.
parameters.n: Principal electron-shell number; not identified with d or b.
parameters.r: Irreducible representation index; dim(V_r) is not automatically a space dimension or shell number.
parameters.sigma: A separately declared two-state spin label; not equated to antipodal vertex signs.

count_proposals.raw_branching: 2*d*2^(d-1) = d*2^d if b=d-1 and the leading2 is an independent spin factor; this interpretation requires its own source.
count_proposals.cross_polytope_flags: 2*d vertices times 2^(d-1) incident facets per vertex = d*2^d flags; here the leading2 counts antipodal vertices, NOT spin.
count_proposals.hypercube_directed_edges: d*2^d oriented edges, a separate exact combinatorial interpretation.
count_proposals.two_sided_group_modes: 2*dim(V_r)^2 under the independently supplied spin factor; first six600-cell bands happen to have dim(V_r)=1..6.

conjectures.statement: The selected A/B tetrahedral networks satisfy exact mutual centers and a lattice-exchange involution.
conjectures.boundary: Not conventional dual face-to-face tetrahedral tilings or a nuclear occupation model.

conjectures.statement: Identity boundary sharing alone imposes a finite growth/coordination limit.
conjectures.residual: A nonzero delta function on a consistent assignment survives every finite identity-seam network.

conjectures.statement: Loss of a parallel spinor means the based tetrahedral comparison is unfillable.
conjectures.residual: All10 correctly based cells fill while triangular parallel assignments vanish; nonparallel lowest patterns survive.

conjectures.statement: The600-cell scalar operator has first six ranks1,4,9,16,25,36; an assumed spin doublet gives2,8,18,32,50,72.
conjectures.boundary: Finite prefix; spin/statistics and native P/N attachment are not derived.

conjectures.statement: Lowest-band filling of that unchanged operator explains neutral atomic occupations.
conjectures.residual: Pb predicts2,8,18,32,22 versus2,8,18,32,18,4; Ca andFe also fail.

conjectures.statement: For principal shell n, capacity is2*n*2^(n-1).
conjectures.residual: At n=3 the proposal is24 versus reference18 and tested600-cell rank18. Alternative grading is a new conjecture, not a repair of this one.

conjectures.statement: F(d)=2*d*2^(d-1) counts vertex-facet incidences of the d-cross-polytope; for d=4, eight vertices each belong to eight tetrahedra, giving64 flags.
conjectures.boundary: Same16-cell has only8 scalar vertex modes,16 after the independent spin factor. Flag count is not its operator capacity.

conjectures.statement: An independently constructed branching/flag comparison map determines which histories give distinct retained channels.
conjectures.first_missing_object: Typed source branch/preparation operations, flag-to-full-channel map and source reason for any coherence identification; do not delete six labels at d=3 to force18.
conjectures.acceptance: Freeze domain, parameter roles, full kernel/residual and transport/reader squares before comparing ranks.

conjectures.statement: Test a distinct canonical flag operator on the actual16-cell, rather than interpreting64 flags as one shell.
conjectures.source: Actual vertices/facets already exported by the capacity experiment.
conjectures.carrier_change: Functions on64 flags replace functions on8 vertices: a new declared task, not a basis change or a native physical state enlargement by inference.
conjectures.operator: Flags(v,F). Join flags sharing F with different vertices; also join flags sharing v whose tetrahedral facets share a triangular face. Use unit-weight scalar graph Laplacian; no fitted phases or weights.
conjectures.test: Compute complete scalar spectral ranks and separately spin-doubled ranks. Candidate grades are distinct eigenvalues in ascending order. Keep geometric dimension d=4 separate from the grade index; compare raw total64 with retained band ranks, not with a silently reindexed shell.
conjectures.falsifier: A claimed64-dimensional single retained band fails if the frozen operator splits it; any claimed atomic ladder must retain all bands and independent filling tests.

conjectures.statement: Bind reciprocal P/N cells and E channels to native source operations, physical preparation and occupation.
conjectures.first_missing_object: Source-supported fitting-to-channel transport and charge/statistics/occupation selection; bare dual geometry is P/N-exchange symmetric.
conjectures.boundary: Closed full fourfold saturation demands P=N, so neutron-rich nuclei require explicit boundary/occupation data.

connection_policy: Graph backlinks and explicit contract attachments connect this net; existing parent contracts and their scientific receipts are not rewritten.
